home.title: Boxes
home.desc: Open a box to get an item or USDT.

box.desc: This box holds {n} items, and each tier shows its odds.
box.confirmDesc: Paid from your balance, then opened right away.
box.openFail: The box did not open. Your balance is unchanged.
box.evNote: Expected value is the odds-weighted average you would receive, with every result taken as USDT, divided by the box price. It is an average over many opens and does not guarantee a single result. An item taken as USDT pays {pct}% of its item value.
box.genNote: This is a generated reference image, not a photo. The item you receive is the model named above.
box.verifyLink: How to verify a result from the value locked before opening
box.receiveDigital: As a code, or taken as USDT
box.receiveCash: Added to your balance on open
box.noReviews: No reviews yet. Only real openings can be reviewed.
box.compareNote: Price per open and odds for this item. No box sells the item outright.
box.guestNote: {n} open, {amount}. After login, your USDT balance pays.
box.takeAmount: If taken as USDT ({pct}% of item value)
box.priceBasisV: Approximate US market price as of October 2026, before tax
box.shipFeeV: Free to {n} countries (chosen on the shipping sheet)
box.belowOdds: Odds of getting less than you paid
box.burstNote: Every open adds {pct}% of the box price to the burst gauge. When Burst comes up (odds {odds}) you receive the whole gauge in USDT, and it restarts from {seed}. The odds of Burst are always the same, however full the gauge is. The gauge belongs to this box and this account, and is paid only when it bursts.
box.ratingBasis: Ratings come from people who received an item, for the item and its delivery.
box.freeLeft: You can open this box {n} times for free.
box.evRetail: Expected value ratio (by item value, average)
box.evCash: If everything is taken as USDT
box.evNotePhysical: The expected value ratio is the probability-weighted average item value of the items divided by the box price. It is an average over many openings and does not guarantee any single result. Taking an item as USDT gives {pct}% of its item value, so the ratio is lower by that much if everything is taken as USDT.

reveal.itemDesc: It is in your inventory, and you can take USDT for it now.
reveal.multiDesc: Your items are in your inventory.
reveal.takenDesc: You took USDT instead of the item.
reveal.takeDesc: You receive {amount} instead of {name}, and this cannot be undone.
reveal.rowHint: Select a row to verify that result.
reveal.shippedDesc: Shipping is requested, and you can follow it in your inventory.
reveal.rowHintReceive: Tap a row to receive or verify that item.

login.title: Log in
login.codeDesc: Enter the 6-digit code sent to your email.
login.terms: By continuing, you agree to the Terms and the Privacy Policy.
login.recoverDesc: A verification code is sent to your email.

charge.title: Add USDT
charge.desc: Send USDT to the address below and it is added to your balance.
charge.loginDesc: Log in to see your deposit address.
charge.addressFail: The address could not be loaded.

verify.title: Verify result
verify.desc: The number is recalculated in this browser from the value locked before opening.
verify.ok: The recalculated result matches the item you received.
verify.bad: The recalculated result does not match the item you received.
verify.failed: The result could not be calculated. The record has empty values.
verify.partial: The number was recalculated and matches. This record has no odds table from that time, so the item could not be checked.
verify.loginLine: Log in to recompute each of your openings.
verify.manualDesc: Paste the values from a result screen or the vault and you get the same number.
verify.inputFail: Enter the revealed value, your device value and the round.
verify.currentTableNote: The item was found with the current odds table. Past openings are checked against the table saved at the time, under My openings.
verify.localNote: This test site creates and stores the value in this browser.

method.step1: Before opening, a value is chosen and its hash is locked first.
method.step2: If a blockchain record is added, the locked value would be recorded before opening, so that it could not be changed afterwards.
method.step3: After opening, the number is recalculated from the revealed value, your device value and the round, and compared with the item you received.
method.notCovered: Shipping, authenticity and the accuracy of the item value are not covered by this verification.

chain.view: View the record on the blockchain
chain.noneBody: This test site does not write the locked value to a blockchain. If a blockchain record is added, the locked value would be recorded before opening, and that record would be opened and compared here.
chain.pendingBody: The blockchain record is not confirmed yet.
chain.ok: The record made before opening, the revealed value and the item you received all match.
chain.mismatchBody: The blockchain record and the opening data are different.
chain.errorBody: The blockchain record could not be loaded.

inv.title: Inventory
inv.desc: Take USDT for your items, or select an item to request shipping. The amount on the right is what you get in USDT (95% of the item value).

empty.shipping: You have no items in shipping.

inv.loginLine: Log in to see your items.
inv.waitingTracking: The tracking number appears once the item ships.
inv.cancelDesc: The item returns to your inventory, and the shipping fee returns to your balance.
inv.cancelFailed: The request could not be cancelled. The item may have shipped already.

ship.title: Ship it
ship.desc: Enter the delivery address, and the item ships after inspection.
ship.errRecipient: Enter a recipient name of two or more characters.
ship.errPhone: Enter the phone number in digits.
ship.errAddress: Enter the full address including the unit.
ship.errPccc: The personal customs code is P followed by 12 digits.
ship.confirmDesc: The item ships to {address}, and the request cannot be cancelled after dispatch.
ship.failed: The shipping request was not accepted. The item is still in your inventory.

take.title: Take USDT
take.desc: Select items to receive {pct}% of their item value in your balance.
take.submit: Take USDT ({n, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}, {amount})
take.confirmDesc: You receive balance instead of the items. Amount to receive: {amount}. After that, they cannot be shipped.
take.cardNote: {amount} of this was funded by card and goes to the balance that cannot be withdrawn.
take.empty: There are no items to take as USDT.
take.failed: USDT was not received. The items are in your inventory.
take.leftLine: {n, plural, one {# item was} other {# items were}} not taken. They are in your inventory.
take.takenGroup: {n, plural, one {# item taken} other {# items taken}}
take.leftGroup: {n, plural, one {# item left} other {# items left}}
take.already: These items were already taken as USDT. Nothing was added again.
take.unknown: The result could not be confirmed. You can check it in your inventory and wallet history.
take.unknownGroup: {n, plural, one {# item not confirmed} other {# items not confirmed}}
take.changed: The items you selected were already handled elsewhere. Nothing was added to your balance here.
take.heldHint: Taking the {n, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} in your inventory as USDT adds up to {amount}.
take.withdrawLink: Take inventory items as USDT and withdraw
take.prefilled: The withdrawable part of what you just received is entered as the amount. Amount entered: {amount}.
take.prefillNone: What you just received went to the balance that cannot be withdrawn, so the amount was not filled in.

balanceSheet.title: Balance
balanceSheet.held: {n, plural, one {# stored item} other {# stored items}}
balanceSheet.login: Log in to see your balance and stored items.

state.notFoundDesc: The address has changed or the screen does not exist.
state.errorDesc: Reload to continue where you left off.
state.offline: You are offline. The app continues when you reconnect.
state.sessionLost: Your session ended. Log in again to continue where you were.
state.movedDesc: The screen at this address now lives in the new design.

guide.title: How it works
guide.desc: Choose a box, open it, then ship the item or take USDT.
guide.pickBody: Each box lists its contents, the odds for each tier and the odds for each item.
guide.openBody: The amount on the button is paid from your balance and the result appears right away.
guide.getBody: Items go to your inventory, and you can ship them or take USDT.
guide.verifyBody: Every result can be recalculated from the value locked before opening.

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.desc: Add USDT, withdraw, and see your history.
wallet.loginLine: Log in to see your balance and history.
wallet.holdLeft: Sent in {h}h {m}m. You can cancel before then.
wallet.cancelDesc: The withdrawal is cancelled and the amount returns to your balance.
wallet.cancelDescOpen: This withdrawal request was never taken from your balance. Cancelling it does not change your balance.
wallet.notDebited: This withdrawal request was never taken from your balance. It did not change your balance.
wallet.cancelFailed: The withdrawal could not be cancelled. Sending may have started.

withdraw.title: Withdraw
withdraw.desc: Enter the network, the destination address and the amount.

errAddress.TRC20: A TRC-20 address starts with T and has 34 characters.
errAddress.BEP20: A BEP-20 address starts with 0x and has 42 characters.

withdraw.errInsufficient: The amount is more than your balance of {balance}.
withdraw.securityFail: Your security settings could not be loaded.
withdraw.gateDesc: To withdraw, connect an authenticator app (Google OTP) first.
withdraw.emailPath: Withdraw with email verification (sent after {hours} hours)
withdraw.confirmDesc: Check the amount you receive and the full address.
withdraw.otpDesc: Enter the 6-digit code shown in your authenticator app.
withdraw.otpWrong: The code is incorrect. You have {left} more attempts.
withdraw.emailDesc: Verify with the emailed code, and the withdrawal is sent after {hours} hours.
withdraw.emailExpired: The code has expired. Request a new code.
withdraw.cancelUnconfirmed: Your balance changed, so the withdrawal was not completed. Nothing was taken from your balance. The request could not be confirmed as cancelled. You can check and cancel it in wallet history.
withdraw.doneDesc: You can follow the status in your wallet history.
withdraw.doneHold: It is sent after {hours} hours, and you can cancel it in your wallet history before then.
withdraw.doneReview: It is sent after a safety review, and you can follow the status in your wallet history.

account.title: Account
account.desc: Balance, vault and security in one place.
account.loginLine: Log in to see your balance, vault and security settings.
account.twoFactorDesc: Withdrawals use the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
account.logoutDesc: Your balance and vault stay with the account.
account.nicknameDesc: Shown on your reviews and records. 2 to 20 characters.
account.nicknameLocked: You can change it again from {date}.
account.passwordDesc: Enter your current password, a new one (12+ characters) and the authenticator code.
account.passwordSocial: Social accounts manage their password with that provider.
account.passwordRule: The new password needs 12 to 128 characters.
account.passwordNeedsApp: Connect an authenticator app first, then change your password.
account.closeDesc: Deleting removes the account, its records, any remaining balance and items in the vault. Take what you want before deleting.
account.closeConfirm: This cannot be undone. The account, its records, remaining balance and vault items are removed.

review.title: Write a review
review.desc: Posted with your record of receiving {name}.
review.photoFail: The photo could not be read. Choose another file.
review.saveFail: Could not save. This item already has a review or storage is full.
review.proofNote: Shown on the box screen with the real opening record.

op.autoNote: You can turn this off in opening settings
op.recovered: This is the result of the box you opened earlier. Nothing was drawn again.
op.pending: Waiting for your balance to update. It is not shown as received until it is. If you close this screen, the item stays in your inventory.
op.failed: Could not take USDT. The item is still in your inventory.
op.setSoundNote: A sound and a short vibration on opening. The result looks the same without them
op.setShortNote: Shortens the opening animation. The result is the same
op.setAutoNote: You receive {pct}% of the item value. No other fee. Items worth 20 times the box price or more are never taken automatically. Applies to this account only
op.autoConfirm: When on, items from a box are not kept. You receive {pct}% of the item value in USDT right away. There is no other fee, and an item taken as USDT cannot be shipped later. Items worth 20 times the box price or more are never taken automatically. This applies to this account only, and you can turn it off at any time in opening settings.
op.recoverLine: You have an opening result you have not seen.
op.autoTookFrom: {name}, item value {ref}. Taken as USDT automatically
op.recoverElsewhere: Another box has an opening result you have not seen

hero.desc: Sign up and open {n} for free.

footer.about1: VOILA is a service where you open boxes to receive physical items or USDT. Every box lists its contents and odds, and items you receive can be shipped to you or taken as USDT.
footer.about2: Every result is computed from values locked before you open, and you can recompute it yourself under Verify a result. Money moves in USDT, and won amounts are a display conversion.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.verifyNote: Checks the pre-locked hash against the opening record.
reviews.agoHour: {n, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} ago
reviews.agoDay: {n, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ago
reviews.agoMonth: {n, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} ago
reviews.agoYear: {n, plural, one {# year} other {# years}} ago

wins.title: Recent results
wins.desc: Items worth <num>{n}x</num> the box price or more are added here, newest first. No review is needed.
wins.none: No item worth <num>{n}x</num> the box price or more has come out yet.
wins.scope: These are openings on this device with this account.
wins.loginLine: Log in to see your records on this device.
wins.priceThen: Price per open at the time
wins.priceNowNote: This record has no price from that time, so it was compared with the current price.
